description: Latest ACTIVE tenders as listed on India's Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP, eprocure.gov.in/cppp) — either the all-portal tender feed ("cppp": central and state e-procurement systems, newest published first) or the Government e-Marketplace bid feed CPPP lists ("gem": GeM bid number, items, buying organisation and ministry, closing date; ordered soonest-closing first). "Latest Indian government tenders", "new GeM bids", "GeM bids from Ministry of Defence". Returns one or more 10-row pages with an optional keyword filter over those pages; CPPP's own keyword search is captcha-gated, so for buyer-specific searches use india_search_tenders.

feed.description: "cppp" = all-portal tender feed (default); "gem" = Government e-Marketplace bids.

page.description: First page to fetch (1-based, default 1). 10 rows per page.

pages.description: How many consecutive pages to fetch (default 1, max 5).

query.description: Optional keywords (all must match) applied to the fetched rows.

name: india_cppp_latest_tenders
title: India Cppp Latest Tenders
